info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Human Resource Management Recruitment-v5-spec
info.description: The Recruitment Management API facilitates the creation and management of recruitment processes within the banking sector. This endpoint allows organizations to initiate hiring procedures, input candidate data, and establish job postings efficiently. Typical consumers include HR professionals and recruitment teams aiming to streamline their hiring workflows. By employing this API, businesses can enhance their talent acquisition strategies and improve overall hiring outcomes.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new recruitment entry in the human resource management system. It will process the provided data to add a candidate or job opening to the records.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a recruitment operation in the human resource management system. It should contain all the necessary details required for processing the recruitment request, following the specified schema format.

201.description: The recruitment resource has been successfully created.
